title: Assembled Joints Between Fittings and Polyethylene (PE) Pressure Pipes - Test of Resistance to Pull Out
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13479) covers Assembled Joints Between Fittings and Polyethylene (PE) Pressure Pipes - Test of Resistance to Pull Out. This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 3501 : 1976 'Assembled joints between fittings and polyethylene ( PE ) pressure pipes — Test of resistance to pull out', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the Committee ( FAD 35 ) and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is drawn specially to the following: a) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. b) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. While adopting this standard the following shall also be observed: The test temperature shall be 27 ± l^'C. clause_3_terminology: Assembled Joints Between Fittings and Polyethylene

dimensional_tolerances: nominal diameter up to and including 63 mm
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
